topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I found out today that someone got a tattoo of one of my pieces. It’s a strange feeling, seeing something I created permanently etched into someone’s skin without my permission. I don’t know what to think. It’s an honor, in a way, but also... it feels like my work has been taken, used in a way I never intended. I wonder if I should reach out, or if that would just make things awkward. What if they don’t even realize they needed to ask? I’m not sure what the right move is here.
